bills.title: The Pizza Friday Act
bills.summary: Makes the last Friday of each month Pizza Friday, and says everyone gets a say in the toppings.
bills.text:
SECTION 1. SHORT TITLE.
This Act may be cited as the "Pizza Friday Act".

SEC. 2. PIZZA FRIDAY.
The last Friday of each month is Pizza Friday.

SEC. 3. TOPPINGS.
Everyone present gets a say in the toppings. Pineapple is a matter of conscience.
